# Physician in the Loop

> How artificial intelligence changes medicine for patients and the people who practice on the front lines. Daily posts, a Friday letter and a podcast.

Created by Ryan Gillum, MD. Daily posts are third-person news wire copy about artificial intelligence in medicine, each item linked to its original source; the Friday letter is an unsigned editorial in the manner of a leader in The Economist, and the special topics are longer pieces on a single question.

## Sections

- [Daily posts](https://physicianintheloop.org/posts/): one post every morning, newest first
- [Friday letter](https://physicianintheloop.org/letters/): the weekly essay with recommendations
- [Special topics](https://physicianintheloop.org/specials/): long pieces on one question
- [Watch list](https://physicianintheloop.org/watch/): the signals that would change the picture
- [Dates](https://physicianintheloop.org/dates/): deadlines, effective dates, hearings
- [Where things stand](https://physicianintheloop.org/where-things-stand/): the long read
- [Topics](https://physicianintheloop.org/topics/): the daily items grouped by kind
- [About](https://physicianintheloop.org/about/)
- [RSS feed](https://physicianintheloop.org/feed.xml)
- [Podcast](https://physicianintheloop.org/podcast/): each morning's post as an audio briefing; podcast feed https://feeds.transistor.fm/physician-in-the-loop
- [For patients](https://physicianintheloop.org/patients/): a weekly letter for patients and families, in plain language
- [AI health law map](https://physicianintheloop.org/law-map/): state and federal laws on AI in health care, each with a physician's read; data at https://physicianintheloop.org/law-map/laws.json
- [Federal AI health law and policy](https://physicianintheloop.org/law-map/federal/): federal statutes, rules, guidance and executive orders on AI in health care, each with a physician's read
- [Explainers](https://physicianintheloop.org/explainers/): plain answers to common questions about AI in medicine, each dated when reviewed
